messages:
Alex: Quick preflight: freeze starts 21:00 PT in ~20m. Posting a short checklist and rollback lanes. Call out blockers or emergency unpins.

Sophia: Running final canary drift and embed-consistency tests on staging. ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pinned (id: canary-2798765430, service: inference, version: v3.14.3). Manual rollback: `/deploy rollback --to v3.14.2 --reason \"emergency\"`.

Maria: Canary telemetry looks stable. Small token drop from cache trimming noticed, not a regression. P95 +8ms.

Ron: Oncall here 61; temp alert set: error_rate > 2.5x baseline OR P95 > baseline + 90ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/launch-freeze

Tim: Release notes snippet posted to Console. Added note about fallback behavior for feature flag.

Dave: Confirm no DB migrations. Just a config toggle (shields.enabled) in config-service. I'll be ready to flip back and will log times.

Sophia: Smoke update: auth flows pass, embed consistency hashes match, small cold-start spike resolved.

Alex: Gate checklist: 1) Canary eval quality within +/-2% 2) Infra metrics within SLO 3) No critical alerts. If any gate fails, post `rollback` and @sre-oncall will execute rollback playbook.

Maria: Emergency unpin (if CLI is unavailable): `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/emergency/unpin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EMERGENCY_TOKEN' -d '{"service":"inference","version":"v3.14.2"}'` (ops token required).

sre-oncall: I'll run the preflight health script now and post results. Pager and phone on.

Alex: Please acknowledge with one-word ack for audit trail.

Sophia: ack
Maria: ack
Ron: ack
Dave: ack
Tim: ack
sre-oncall: ack

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Status update: canary-2798765430 healthy after 5m. Next update in 5m. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks all 61; keep channel quiet unless a rollback or incident. Pinning the preflight checklist to the thread. :lock:
